answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the app never answered on port 8080 within 180s (HTTP 000, no response, lines 1162-1165). The excerpt cuts off before the app's startup output, so the cause is not visible. The PR adds a Flyway migration (V6_20261118120000000) and new catalog services, so a boot-time failure there would repeat on retry. Check the application startup log for migration or bean-wiring errors before retrying.
